description: Read the message history of a support conversation
name: read_support_chat

message.description: Human-readable rendering of the conversation history.

messages.description: The messages in the conversation, oldest first.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the message was created.

role.description: Author role, e.g. 'visitor' for the user or an agent role for support.

status.description: Outcome of the read: 'empty' when there are no messages yet, 'ok' when messages were returned.
